author: Freebuff4 (fresh-holdout lane; blind to parent recovery implementation and to all prior Jev outcomes)

human-natural query text, never a source field spelling or offset
no field or query taken from the original70 case set
no preference for anything already recovered elsewhere (recovery outputs were never read)
